file_name: Vets Central - Vital Vet Animal Hospital - Third-party questionnaire - Phase 1 consultation - 28 September 2026.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Vital Vet Animal Hospital and Vets Central (including the Swan Valley Vet Centre) are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Vets Central and/or Vital Vet Animal Hospital.
